name: Quantum Engraving #001 — Birth of Light
description:
The exact inception of laser-matter interaction: a high-coherence Gaussian Nd:YAG laser beam (λ = 1064 nm) strikes the reflective crystalline plane of a semiconductor silicon substrate. Within microseconds, concentrated photonic absorption initiates a steep transient thermal gradient, creating an incandescent melt core surrounded by concentric photonic diffraction and acoustic ripples propagating into the cold lattice.

Conceptually derived from Master's Thesis research in Nanophotonics and numerical simulations in COMSOL Multiphysics ('Modeling and implementation of laser engraving considering the impact of layers material', University of Tabriz). This artwork is a high-fidelity visual translation of transient thermal flux equations (Q_laser) and non-equilibrium surface phase changes.

Note: This artwork is an artistic interpretation inspired by multiphysics simulations and theoretical models; it does not claim to be a raw numerical export.
creator: Alireza Mahdipour Shadkam
